rules: Use descriptive fonts for status indicators.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders for standard cards, 2px for status highlighting on POS cards.

grids.dense_view: gap-2 for high-density fast-casual POS environments

layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Left-align dense content.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-4 to p-6 for card internals to ensure touch-target sizing on POS tablets.

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-lg) for interactive elements.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease), never transition: all

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA minimums. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g., 🤖🧠) for icons.
Prioritize pre-existing components from src/components/ui when building standard forms/dialogs.
Include data-testid attribute for all interactive elements to enable robust testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Update constants/colors.js: change billPrintedBg from #E8F5E9 to #FFEDD5.
Maintain the existing 2px #329937 border on the bill printed cards.

Ensure inner card elements (like the header pill and delivery buttons) switch their background to #FFFFFF when the card is in the 'printed' state. This preserves WCAG contrast and aesthetic cleanliness against the new #FFEDD5 background.
